english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday verb for delaying or staying until someone or something arrives.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when a person or group waits for someone or something, or simply stays waiting.

examples.english: Wait for me a moment first.
I await you at the entrance.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 mun4 hau2 dang2 nei5
